mapper.sql:
FROM comment c JOIN post p ON p.post_id = c.post_id LEFT JOIN members m ON m.member_id = c.writer_id LEFT JOIN region r ON r.region_id = m.region_id
AND ( c.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND r.region_name LIKE CONCAT(#{regionName}, '%')
AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
AND c.deleted_at IS NOT NULL
mapper.select:
SELECT c.comment_id, c.post_id, CASE WHEN c.deleted_at IS NOT NULL THEN '삭제된 댓글입니다.' ELSE c.content END AS content, COALESCE(m.nickname, '탈퇴한 회원') AS writer_nickname, p.title AS post_title, COALESCE(r.region_name, '지역 미등록') AS region_name, CASE WHEN c.deleted_at IS NULL THEN 'VISIBLE' ELSE 'DELETED' END AS status, c.created_at
ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.comment_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
